definitions.explanation: The act of conveying thoughts, feelings, or ideas through words, art, or other means. Also refers to the way something is expressed.

examples.japanese: {気持|きも}ちを{言葉|ことば}で{表現|ひょうげん}するのが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to express feelings in words.

examples.japanese: この{表現|ひょうげん}は{失礼|しつれい}に{聞|き}こえるかもしれない。
{芸術|げいじゅつ}は{自己|じこ}{表現|ひょうげん}の{一|ひと}つの{形|かたち}だ。
examples.english: Art is one form of self-expression.

notes:
{表現|ひょうげん} covers any form of expression — verbal, artistic, written, or emotional. It functions both as a noun ("an expression") and as a する verb ("to express").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表現|ひょうげん}する: to express
- {表現|ひょうげん}{力|りょく}: expressive ability
- {表現|ひょうげん}{方法|ほうほう}: way of expressing
- {自己|じこ}{表現|ひょうげん}: self-expression
- {表現|ひょうげん}が{豊|ゆた}か: rich in expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言|い}い{方|かた}: way of saying something (more casual, spoken language)
- {描写|びょうしゃ}: depiction, description (more literary/visual)

NOTE:
In language study, {表現|ひょうげん} often refers to set phrases or ways of saying things: この{表現|ひょうげん}は{自然|しぜん}ですか (Is this expression natural?).
